pilot_boundary: Lower Manhattan south of Canal Street

service_requests_311.name: NYC 311 faded/after-repaving line markings (lane lines and crosswalks mixed)
service_requests_311.note: Socrata default page is 100; fetch paginates with $limit/$offset/$order.

school_zones.name: DOE school points (elementary / K-8) within 800 ft of the node
school_zones.note: Attendance-zone polygons cover the whole bbox, so the UI filter uses school proximity.

vision_zero_crashes.name: NYPD Motor Vehicle Collisions — pedestrian injured or killed
vision_zero_crashes.filter: bbox Lower Manhattan; crash_date >= 2020-01-01; pedestrians injured or killed > 0

source_versions.service_requests_311: NYC 311 faded/after-repaving line markings since 2020 (150 rows, SODA paginated)
source_versions.school_zones: DOE school points: elementary/K-8 within 800 ft (not attendance-zone polygons)
source_versions.vision_zero_crashes: NYPD Motor Vehicle Collisions pedestrian injured/killed since 2020 (h9gi-nx95)

note: Live NYC downloads fall back to committed fixtures when an endpoint fails. LION gdb is not required for tests; candidate generation uses expanded fixtures if the gdb is missing. Scoring is a sklearn logistic ranker; the pixel heuristic is the baseline, not a detector. 311 Line/Marking mixes lane lines with crosswalks. Candidates are intersection nodes, not crosswalk polygons.
